subject: Weekly forecast: commit signal sync and pre-call checklist
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly forecast: commit signal sync and pre-call checklist

Team —

Quick reminder: our Friday commit submission window closes at 5pm PT. I want to run a tight 20-minute prep before the finance handoff to make sure the deals we've tagged as commit have the right signal and the short list is clean. Goal: minimize over-commit and surface any gating docs or procurement blockers.

Agenda for the 20-min pre-call (Thursday EOD prep, Friday 9:30am sync):
- 9:30am: Roll call and confidence status (2 min per deal)
- Confirm close date and next deliverable (who owns what)
- Flag open items that should prevent commit (PO, SOC2 evidence, signed MSA)
- Final value & ARR reconciliation against CRM
- Quick contingency plan if a top deal slips (fallback to pipeline)

Please update the Q2_commit_snapshot.xlsx in the Drive folder by EOD Thursday with the latest expected close date and confidence percent. I attached the current snapshot for reference.

Ask: lauren — can you pull the final pricing notes for ND-2027-045 and add a one-line risk item if procurement is still outstanding?
Marcus — please confirm host region and any special SLA ask in the drive doc.
Rachel — if there are any legal redlines not resolved, flag under the deal comments.

I’ll run the 20-min sync Friday at 9:30am PT. If you can’t make it, please drop a short note in-thread with your votes.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, North America Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q2_commit_snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, marcus.lin@redwood.com, rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 05 May 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast: commit signal sync and pre-call checklist

Karthik —

Got it. I updated ND-2027-045 row with the latest pricing: 3-tier enterprise discount applied, net ARR moved to $138k ARR (was $150k). Procurement at Acme has asked for demo re-run next week which is a gating item — marked under "open_items". I also added a one-line redline summary captured from Legal.

Notes:
- Confidence: 70% (procurement + third-party security questionnaire remaining)
- Required by close: signed PO + completed security questionnaire (SOC2 excerpts already provided)

I’ll be on the 9:30 sync. If procurement confirms the demo before Friday afternoon we can keep commit; otherwise we should push to the best-effort pipeline and mark as at-risk.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
AE, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.docx (contains action owner matrix)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 05 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast: commit signal sync and pre-call checklist

Quick update from Legal & CS side —
- Legal has two minor redlines in the MSA (indemnity language + data residency clause). I attached the doc with comments.
- Customer (Nimbus) has requested 90-day data deletion SLA; product told CS this is doable but needs confirmation from infra team (marcus).

I pushed the annotated MSA into the Drive link and added a short note on how this impacts go/no-go. If Marcus can confirm data residency options by EOD tomorrow, we can keep the deal in commit, otherwise we should mark it as upside.

-Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Manager, Legal Ops & Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ND-2027-045_MSA_comments.pdf (pdf, 3 pages)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 05 May 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast: commit signal sync and pre-call checklist

FYI — Infra confirmed we can offer APAC region isolation and a 90-day deletion SLA; engineering will need a short implementation ticket but it's not a blocker for Q2 close. I updated the Drive notes and dropped a JIRA link for the infra task.

I’ll join the 9:30 sync (dial-in in calendar invite). For ND-2027-045 I move to COMMIT at adjusted ARR $138k with risk note: "procurement demo pending".

Marcus
